name: IPM Avanea Eco Management
decision_note: IPM Group manager of the SIH waste-management co-investment fund IPM Avanea Eco (battery, tar and plastic recycling projects); investment window closed Dec 2023, now divesting.

evidence.quote: The fund was created as a fixed-term investment vehicle with a projected 10-year term, initiating its market activities in 2020 and terminating its investment window in December 2023.
The fund is currently its divestment phase, with the manager progressively winding down holdings and returning capital to its investors.

analyst_notes: Fund IPM Avanea Eco s.r.o. (IČO 52261948) co-owned by National Development Fund II (SIH). Investments per RÚZ 2025 notes: ShredCo j.s.a. (EUR 10m 2022 + EUR 3.2m Dec 2023), Green Recycle s.r.o. (EUR 1.05m Dec 2023), SPzO s.r.o. (EUR 5.83m Dec 2023) - equity into waste-processing project companies, none after 2023. Same IPM Group as sk-reference/ipm-growth (another analyst; IPM Growth s.r.o., IČO 52151573, shares the managing director Ing. Adrian Vyčítal) - candidate for a brand-level merge if IPM Group is ever included.
